rows_data = cells('Knot measurements', 'B702:C706')
pts = sorted(rows_data, key=lambda p: p[0])
# Integral from 2 to 18 using trapezoidal rule on segments
x_start = 2
x_end = 18

def get_y(val):
    for i in range(len(pts)-1):
        x0, y0 = pts[i]
        x1, y1 = pts[i+1]
        if x0 <= val <= x1:
            return y0 + (y1 - y0) * (val - x0) / (x1 - x0)
    return None

# collect all relevant x points: x_start, x_end, and any knot x strictly between them
xs = [x_start] + [p[0] for p in pts if x_start < p[0] < x_end] + [x_end]
xs = sorted(list(set(xs)))

integral = 0.0
for i in range(len(xs)-1):
    x_a = xs[i]
    x_b = xs[i+1]
    y_a = get_y(x_a)
    y_b = get_y(x_b)
    integral += 0.5 * (y_a + y_b) * (x_b - x_a)
result = integral
